reason: In our house the clothes have always been washed by hand at the tap, and it works fine, so I don't see why I would spend ₹22,000 on a machine now. And if I ever did want one, my inverter can already run a normal semi-automatic, or I would just buy a bigger inverter that runs the whole house.
objection: I don't need a battery inside a washing machine when I already have an inverter at home. A plain semi-automatic costs about half this, so I'd be paying ₹10,000 extra for a battery I already have.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour I trust had one running for a year with no trouble, and the dealer brought the price down near a plain semi-automatic, about ₹14,000, I would think about it for my wife.
